stock.description: Xiabuxiabu Catering Management (China) Holdings Co., Ltd. functions as an investment holding entity primarily engaged in running Chinese hotpot eateries across the People's Republic of China. By the close of 2021, specifically December 31st, the firm managed a substantial network of hotpot establishments. This included 841 Xiabuxiabu branded outlets spread across 132 cities within roughly 21 provinces and three direct-controlled municipalities. Additionally, its Coucou brand boasted 183 restaurants in 42 cities, covering approximately 19 provinces, including key locations like Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, and Hong Kong. Beyond its restaurant operations, the company provides catering services and markets various condiment products alongside other merchandise. Furthermore, its activities encompass the slaughtering, processing, cold storage, and commercial distribution of raw materials, as well as involvement in the construction sector. Established in 1998, the enterprise maintains its primary office in Beijing, located in the People's Republic of China. Ultimately, Xiabuxiabu Catering Management (China) Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Ying Qi Investments Limited.
